summary: This class discusses various customs of the month of Elul according to the traditions of Aleppo. It explores historical practices regarding Selihot, the ruling on blowing the shofar during Elul, and the custom concerning Psalm 27 after prayers.
questions: When were Selihot traditionally said according to the old customs of Aleppo?
Did the original Aleppo custom include blowing the shofar during Elul?
Is saying Psalm 27 after prayers a communal custom in the Aleppo tradition?
